game.title: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Chicago Bears

lede: Chicago Bears carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#10 in EPA per play), while Tampa Bay Buccaneers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#3 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Chicago Bears −5.0 with a fair total of 44.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass offence vs Chicago Bears pass defence, which sits −0.244 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
